title: Pokémon UNITE to close servers after five years; competitive farewell set in Tokyo
summary: Pokémon Unite will end its service on March 23, 2027, bringing the multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game's run on Nintendo Switch and mobile devices to a close after more than five years.
